dispositions.topic_text: Timestamp representation and monotonicity when revisions move within one clock tick
dispositions.reason: A04-3 sets last-changed to the action's instant ('now'), the one clock reading the action takes (A04, L16); it decides no strictly later value. Two changes read in one clock tick record equal instants, and the revision, which moves by exactly one each time, orders them. Requiring a strictly later instant would be a new rule the owner has not taken.

dispositions.topic_text: Required-test action coverage for A04-3 and A04-6 revision and no-change guarantees
dispositions.what: How completely the bound checks show the invariant — every conjunct, case and action the rule covers — is judged on the tests' code at State 8 (witness_material) and carried to the Factory checks issue; State 2 only says what must be shown (owner, 2026-11-24).
keeps:
for action a on record r in {Project, Customer} that may move r.revision:
  a.stated_revision != r.revision => refused, r unchanged   -- A04-2
  accepted and changed(r) and r keeps a revision   -- A04-3
                          => r.revision' = r.revision + 1
                             and r.last_changed' = now
  accepted erasure, anonymisation or deletion => r has no revision after   -- A04-4
  r has no revision and a.stated_revision present => refused as stale   -- A04-5
  accepted and not changed(r) => r.revision' = r.revision   -- A04-6
options: Require coverage of every action to which the universally quantified invariants A04-3 and A04-6 apply.
Add separately bound Required tests for the omitted actions and bind the existing A05 no-change cases to A04-6 as applicable.
Narrow A04-3 and A04-6 to a smaller explicit action set, reconciling that change with State 1.
consequences: Exhaustive or separately bound coverage shows the accepted revision and no-change guarantees for lifting, ending and resuming; representative-only coverage can admit code that violates those guarantees outside correction and restriction; narrowing the invariant would weaken an accepted State 1 obligation.
